company.name: MNZL
company.shortDescription: Asset-backed financing. Digital access to capital. Tech-enabled credit decisioning.
company.description:
MNZL is on a mission to expand access to capital for Egyptians.

Every person who owns an asset has accumulated wealth in it. When they want liquidity for their projects and needs, they should be able to tap into it as easily as withdrawing from a bank.

With an innovative digital platform and products, we are working on making digital access to capital a reality, and building the future of asset-backed financing in Africa.

productsAndServices.description: A digital wallet app that allows users to add their real estate or vehicles as assets to secure financing.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $3,500,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $19,434,081 to $19,434,081, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 80 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 51 (+2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
